legacyIntro: This device contains data from v{version}. Version 2.10.0 can no longer convert the old database. Your original data is intact on this device.
legacyIntroUnknown: This device contains data from an earlier version. Version 2.10.0 can no longer convert the old database. Your original data is intact on this device.
legacyKeepOpen: Keep the app open. Cancellation takes effect after the current file finishes.
legacyGeneratedNote: The backup is still inside the app. Save a copy outside the app to keep it after uninstalling.
legacyShareConfirmed: I’ve checked that the backup was saved outside the app
legacyDownloadVerified: Saved to Downloads/{name}. The file size has been verified.
legacySharedVerified: You confirmed that {name} was saved outside the app.
legacyRecoverOne: 1. Uninstall Moodiary 2.10.0. Keep the backup file.
legacyRecoverTwo: 2. Install version 2.7.3 and import the backup ZIP.
legacyRecoverThree: 3. Update to 2.9.2 without uninstalling. Open the app and finish the migration.
legacySpaceError: There isn’t enough free space to create the backup. Free up space and try again.
legacyLargeFile: “{name}” is too large for this backup format (4 GiB limit). Save that file separately.
legacyExportError: The app couldn’t read the source files or write the backup. Check the device storage and try again.
legacySaveFailed: Couldn’t verify the saved copy. Check the available space in Downloads and try again.
legacyShareFailed: Couldn’t share the backup. Please try again.
legacyShareInsufficientSpace: There isn’t enough cache space to copy the backup for sharing. Choose “Save to Downloads” instead.
legacyProbeNote: Retry to check your data and resume startup.
legacyAbandonConfirm: Confirm and give up old data
legacyAbandonWarning: No backup has been confirmed outside the app. If you continue, you won’t be able to recover your old diaries through this app.
legacyAbandonSaved: Your backup has been saved. Continue using the app without your old diaries?
migrationStepEditorDesc: Converts old-format content to the new editor format; originals are backed up first
migrationContentIntro: The new editor needs your diaries upgraded to a new format before you can continue.
migrationStepContentDesc: Upgrades to the new editor format; all diaries are backed up first
migrationContentDoneSubtitle: All diaries now use the new format
migrationLandingNote: Do not exit the app during migration. No old data is deleted until migration succeeds.
migrationRunningSubtitle: Keep the app in the foreground and do not close it
migrationDataSafeNote: No old data is deleted until migration succeeds
migrationFailedSubtitle: {count} entries failed to migrate; the rest are done. Originals are backed up — retrying loses nothing.
migrationErrorSubtitle: An error occurred during migration. Originals are backed up — retrying loses nothing.
migrationFailedNote: The log contains only error details, never diary content. No old data is deleted until migration succeeds.
